2608.02124.title: HAFI-VLM: A Frequency Perspective for Diagnosing and Enhancing Visual Perception in Vision-Language Models
2608.02124.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable when predictions require fine-grained visual evidence. We identify a previously overlooked cause: spectral response rigidity. Despite substantial frequency variation across images and tasks, pretrained vision encoders exhibit persistent, encoder-specific layerwise spectral profiles that change only marginally under downstream fine-tuning. Since pretrained vision encoders only receive images, they cannot adapt spectral extraction to the evidence required by the current query. We therefore propose HAFI-VLM, which introduces a task-conditioned frequency pathway while preserving the pretrained semantic representation. Hierarchical Adaptive Frequency Injection (HAFI) retrieves complementary low-, mid-, and high-frequency evidence at multiple encoder depths using text-modulated, spatially aligned cross-attention. A Visual Enrichment Layer Adapter further recalibrates shallow LLM attention to effectively utilize the enriched visual tokens. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL demonstrate consistent improvements in general VQA, text-rich understanding, and hallucination robustness, outperforming representation-level enhancement methods and most resolution- or cropping-based approaches without additional high-resolution encoding. Mechanistic analyses show that HAFI restores task-dependent spectral allocation while retaining semantic attention, establishing frequency enrichment as a distinct and effective route for improving VLM perception.
2608.02124.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）在需要細緻視覺證據的預測中仍然不可靠。我們識別出一個先前被忽視的原因：光譜響應剛性。儘管圖像和任務之間的頻率變化相當大，預訓練的視覺編碼器仍然顯示出持久的、編碼器特定的層次光譜特徵，這些特徵在下游微調中僅發生微小變化。由於預訓練的視覺編碼器僅接收圖像，因此無法將光譜提取調整為當前查詢所需的證據。因此，我們提出了HAFI-VLM，該模型在保留預訓練語義表示的同時，引入了一個任務條件的頻率通道。分層自適應頻率注入（HAFI）利用文本調制的、空間對齊的交叉注意力，在多個編碼器深度檢索互補的低頻、中頻和高頻證據。一個視覺增強層適配器進一步重新校準淺層LLM注意力，以有效利用增強的視覺標記。在LLaVA-1.5和Qwen2.5-VL上的實驗顯示，在一般的VQA、文本豐富理解和幻覺穩健性方面的一致改進，超越了表示層級增強方法以及大多數基於解析度或裁剪的方法，而無需額外的高解析度編碼。機制分析顯示，HAFI恢復了任務依賴的光譜分配，同時保留語義注意力，確立了頻率增強作為改善VLM感知的一條獨特且有效的途徑。
